225:     #[doc = include_str!("../docs/routing/route.md")]
226:     pub fn route<T>(mut self, path: &str, service: T) -> Self
227:     where
228:         T: Service<Request<B>, Response = Response, Error = Infallible> + Clone + Send + 'static,
229:         T::Future: Send + 'static,
230:     {
231:         if path.is_empty() {
232:             panic!("Invalid route: empty path");
233:         }
234: 
235:         let service = match try_downcast::<Router<B>, _>(service) {
236:             Ok(_) => {
237:                 panic!("Invalid route: `Router::route` cannot be used with `Router`s. Use `Router::nest` instead")
238:             }
239:             Err(svc) => svc,
240:         };
241: 
242:         let id = RouteId::next();
243: 
244:         let service = match try_downcast::<MethodRouter<B, Infallible>, _>(service) {
245:             Ok(method_router) => {
246:                 if let Some((route_id, Endpoint::MethodRouter(prev_method_router))) = self
247:                     .node
248:                     .path_to_route_id
249:                     .get(path)
250:                     .and_then(|route_id| self.routes.get(route_id).map(|svc| (*route_id, svc)))
251:                 {
252:                     // if we're adding a new `MethodRouter` to a route that already has one just
253:                     // merge them. This makes `.route("/", get(_)).route("/", post(_))` work
254:                     let service =
255:                         Endpoint::MethodRouter(prev_method_router.clone().merge(method_router));
256:                     self.routes.insert(route_id, service);
257:                     return self;
258:                 } else {
259:                     Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router)
260:                 }
261:             }
262:             Err(service) => Endpoint::Route(Route::new(service)),
263:         };
264: 
265:         if let Err(err) = self.node.insert(path, id) {
266:             self.panic_on_matchit_error(err);
267:         }
268: 
269:         self.routes.insert(id, service);
270: 
271:         self
272:     }

274:     #[doc = include_str!("../docs/routing/nest.md")]
275:     pub fn nest<T>(mut self, path: &str, svc: T) -> Self
276:     where
277:         T: Service<Request<B>, Response = Response, Error = Infallible> + Clone + Send + 'static,
278:         T::Future: Send + 'static,
279:     {
280:         if path.is_empty() {
281:             panic!("Invalid route: empty path");
282:         }
283: 
284:         if path.contains('*') {
285:             panic!("Invalid route: nested routes cannot contain wildcards (*)");
286:         }
287: 
288:         let prefix = path;
289: 
290:         if path == "/" {
291:             self.nested_at_root = true;
292:         }
293: 
294:         self.remember_nested_prefix(path);
295: 
296:         match try_downcast::<Router<B>, _>(svc) {
297:             // if the user is nesting a `Router` we can implement nesting
298:             // by simplying copying all the routes and adding the prefix in
299:             // front
300:             Ok(router) => {
301:                 let Router {
302:                     mut routes,
303:                     node,
304:                     fallback,
305:                     // nesting a router that has something nested at root
306:                     // doesn't mean something is nested at root in _this_ router
307:                     // thus we don't need to propagate that
308:                     nested_at_root: _,
309:                     ..
310:                 } = router;
311: 
312:                 if let Fallback::Custom(_) = fallback {
313:                     panic!("Cannot nest `Router`s that has a fallback");
314:                 }
315: 
316:                 for (id, nested_path) in node.route_id_to_path {
317:                     let route = routes.remove(&id).unwrap();
318:                     let full_path = if &*nested_path == "/" {
319:                         path.to_owned()
320:                     } else {
321:                         format!("{}{}", path, nested_path)
322:                     };
323:                     self = match route {
324:                         Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router) => self.route(
325:                             &full_path,
326:                             method_router.layer(layer_fn(|s| StripPrefix::new(s, prefix))),
327:                         ),
328:                         Endpoint::Route(route) => {
329:                             self.route(&full_path, StripPrefix::new(route, prefix))
330:                         }
331:                     };
332:                 }
333: 
334:                 debug_assert!(routes.is_empty());
335:             }
336:             // otherwise we add a wildcard route to the service
337:             Err(svc) => {
338:                 let path = if path == "/" {
339:                     format!("/*{}", NEST_TAIL_PARAM)
340:                 } else {
341:                     format!("{}/*{}", path, NEST_TAIL_PARAM)
342:                 };
343: 
344:                 self = self.route(&path, strip_prefix::StripPrefix::new(svc, prefix));
345:             }
346:         }
347: 
348:         self
349:     }

353:         let Router {

355:             node,
356:             fallback,
357:             nested_at_root,
358:             ..
359:         } = other;

361:         for (id, route) in routes {

365:                 .expect("no path for route id. This is a bug in axum. Please file an issue");

367:                 Endpoint::MethodRouter(route) => self.route(path, route),

377:                 panic!("Cannot merge two `Router`s that both have a fallback")
378:             }
379:         };
380: 
381:         self.nested_at_root = self.nested_at_root || nested_at_root;

383:         self

609:     fn remember_nested_prefix(&mut self, prefix: &str) {
610:         if prefix.is_empty() {
611:             return;
612:         }
613:         if self
614:             .nest_policy
615:             .known_prefixes
616:             .iter()
617:             .any(|known| known.as_ref() == prefix)
618:         {
619:             return;
620:         }
621:         self.nest_policy.known_prefixes.push(Arc::from(prefix));
622:     }
623: 
624:     fn resolve_known_prefix<'a>(&'a self, prefix: &'a str) -> &'a str {
625:         if let Some(known) = self
626:             .nest_policy
627:             .known_prefixes
628:             .iter()
629:             .find(|known| known.as_ref() == prefix)
630:         {
631:             known.as_ref()
632:         } else {
633:             prefix
634:         }
635:     }
636: 
637:     fn normalize_prefix<'a>(&self, prefix: &'a str) -> Cow<'a, str> {
638:         if prefix.is_empty() {
639:             return Cow::Borrowed(prefix);
640:         }
641:         if self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash && !prefix.starts_with('/') {
642:             Cow::Owned(format!("/{}", prefix))
643:         } else {
644:             Cow::Borrowed(prefix)
645:         }
646:     }
647: 
648:     fn ensure_absolute_path<'a>(&self, path: &'a str) -> Cow<'a, str> {
649:         if path.starts_with('/') {
650:             Cow::Borrowed(path)
651:         } else if self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash {
652:             if path.is_empty() {
653:                 Cow::Borrowed("/")
654:             } else {
655:                 Cow::Owned(format!("/{}", path))
656:             }
657:         } else if path.is_empty() {
658:             Cow::Borrowed("/")
659:         } else {
660:             Cow::Borrowed(path)
661:         }
662:     }
663: 
664:     fn strip_uri_path(&self, path: &str, prefix: &str) -> String {
665:         let prefix = self.resolve_known_prefix(prefix);
666:         let stripped = if let Some(rest) = path.strip_prefix(prefix) {
667:             rest
668:         } else if self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash {
669:             path
670:         } else {
671:             path
672:         };
673:         self.ensure_absolute_path(stripped).into_owned()
674:     }

676:     fn split_path_and_query<'a>(&self, uri: &'a Uri) -> Option<(&'a str, Option<&'a str>)> {
677:         uri.path_and_query().map(|pq| {
678:             let query = if self.nest_policy.preserve_query {
679:                 pq.query()
680:             } else {
681:                 None
682:             };
683:             (pq.path(), query)
684:         })
685:     }
686: 
687:     fn join_path_and_query(&self, path: &str, query: Option<&str>) -> Option<http::uri::PathAndQuery> {
688:         let path = self.ensure_absolute_path(path);
689:         if self.nest_policy.preserve_query {
690:             if let Some(query) = query {
691:                 Some(
692:                     format!("{}?{}", path, query)
693:                         .parse::<http::uri::PathAndQuery>()
694:                         .unwrap(),
695:                 )
696:             } else {
697:                 Some(path.parse().unwrap())
698:             }
699:         } else {
700:             Some(path.parse().unwrap())
701:         }
702:     }
703: 
704:     fn copy_uri_scheme_authority(&self, uri: &Uri) -> http::uri::Parts {
705:         let mut parts = http::uri::Parts::default();
706:         parts.scheme = uri.scheme().cloned();
707:         parts.authority = uri.authority().cloned();
708:         let _ = self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash;
709:         parts
710:     }

712:     pub(crate) fn rebuild_uri(&self, uri: &Uri, new_path: &str) -> Uri {
713:         let query = if let Some((_, query)) = self.split_path_and_query(uri) {
714:             query
715:         } else if self.nest_policy.preserve_query {
716:             None
717:         } else {
718:             None
719:         };
720:         let path_and_query = self.join_path_and_query(new_path, query);
721:         let mut parts = self.copy_uri_scheme_authority(uri);
722:         parts.path_and_query = path_and_query;
723:         Uri::from_parts(parts).unwrap()
724:     }

726:     pub(crate) fn rewrite_uri_with_prefix(&self, uri: &Uri, prefix: &str) -> Uri {
727:         let prefix = self.normalize_prefix(prefix);
728:         if prefix.is_empty() || prefix.as_ref() == "/" {
729:             return self.rebuild_uri(uri, uri.path());
730:         }
731:         if !self.prefix_matches_uri(uri, prefix.as_ref())
732:             && self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash
733:         {
734:             return self.rebuild_uri(uri, uri.path());
735:         }
736:         let remainder = self.nested_path_remainder(uri.path(), prefix.as_ref());
737:         let stripped = self.strip_uri_path(uri.path(), prefix.as_ref());
738:         if remainder.starts_with('/') || stripped.starts_with('/') {
739:             self.rebuild_uri(uri, stripped.as_str())
740:         } else {
741:             self.rebuild_uri(uri, stripped.as_str())
742:         }
743:     }
744: 
745:     pub(crate) fn rewrite_uri_path(&self, uri: &Uri, new_path: &str) -> Uri {
746:         let new_path = if self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash {
747:             new_path
748:         } else {
749:             new_path
750:         };
751:         self.rebuild_uri(uri, new_path)
752:     }
753: 
754:     fn prefix_matches_uri(&self, uri: &Uri, prefix: &str) -> bool {
755:         let prefix = self.resolve_known_prefix(prefix);
756:         if prefix.is_empty() {
757:             true
758:         } else if uri.path() == prefix {
759:             true
760:         } else if self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash && prefix == "/" {
761:             true
762:         } else {
763:             uri.path().starts_with(prefix)
764:         }
765:     }
766: 
767:     fn nested_path_remainder<'a>(&self, path: &'a str, prefix: &str) -> &'a str {
768:         let prefix = self.resolve_known_prefix(prefix);
769:         if let Some(rest) = path.strip_prefix(prefix) {
770:             if rest.is_empty() {
771:                 "/"
772:             } else if self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash && !rest.starts_with('/') {
773:                 rest
774:             } else {
775:                 rest
776:             }
777:         } else {
778:             path
779:         }
780:     }
781: 
782:     fn trailing_slash_target(&self, path: &str) -> String {
783:         if let Some(without_tsr) = path.strip_suffix('/') {
784:             if self.nest_policy.ensure_leading_slash && !without_tsr.starts_with('/') {
785:                 format!("/{}", without_tsr)
786:             } else {
787:                 without_tsr.to_owned()
788:             }
789:         } else if path.is_empty() {
790:             "/".to_owned()
791:         } else {
792:             format!("{}/", path)
793:         }
794:     }
795: }
